summary: Widens the onboarding_snapshot_lines kind CHECK to the three line kinds the snapshot now emits (former_owner_receivable, former_owner_refund, ap_detail_restored). No rows change.

preflight.name: onboarding_snapshot_lines exists (483)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'onboarding_snapshot_lines'

preflight.name: every existing line uses one of the original six kinds
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM onboarding_snapshot_lines WHERE kind NOT IN ('gl_opening_balance','ar_detail','ar_aging_item','prepaid_detail','ap_detail','unsupported_detail')

expected_changes: Replaces CHECK onboarding_snapshot_lines_kind_check with the original six kinds plus former_owner_receivable, former_owner_refund and ap_detail_restored.
No onboarding_snapshot_lines, stage-event or batch rows change.

verify.name: the CHECK now admits ap_detail_restored and both former-owner kinds
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'onboarding_snapshot_lines_kind_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%ap_detail_restored%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%former_owner_receivable%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%former_owner_refund%'
